Name: Formal limit definition/Formell gränsvärdedefinition
Limit value in infinity/Gränsvärde i oändligheten
Basic relationship: $math{lim{x->\inf, f(x)}=L} means that f(x) approaches L for any large x

Name: Infinite limit value/oändliga gränsvärde
Basic relationship: $math{lim{x->a, f(x)}=\inf} means f(x) greater than any number by choosing x sufficiently close to a, (Improper limit/Oegentlig gränsvärde)

Name: Substitution law
Basic relationship: $math{lim{x->a, g(x)} = L}, $math{lim{x->a, f(x)} = f(L)} -> $math{lim{x->a, f(g(x))} = f(lim{x->a, g(x)}) = f(L)}

Name: Squeeze theorem, squeeze law
Basic relationship: $math{g(x) <= f(x) <= h(x)}, $math{a in [A, B]} -> $math{lim{x->a} g(a)=h(a)} -> $math{lim{x->a, f(x)}=lim{x->a, g(x)}=lim{x->a, h(x)}}

Name: Informal limit definition/Informell gränsvärdedefinition
Forced fractional/radical simplification (lim->\inf)
Basic relationship: Order of growth: $math{1 < ln(x) < x < x*ln(x) < x^2 < x^3 < ... < 2^x < 3^x < ...}

Name: Difference to fraction
Basic relationship:
(Exceptions to logarithms and other difference bindings), ($math{lim{x->a, A(x)} = \inf}, $math{lim{x->a, B(x)} = \inf})
$math{lim{x->a, A(x)-B(x)} = lim{x->a, (A(x)-B(x))(A(x)+B(x))/(A(x)+B(x))} = lim{x->a, (A^2(x)-B^2(x))/(A(x)+B(x))}}

Name: Substitution to growth order

Basic relationship: $math{lim{x->\inf, ln(+{k=0, len(A)-1, A[k]x^k})/ln(+{k=0, len(B)-1, B[k]x^k})} = lim{x->\inf, (ln(x^(len(A)-1)) + ln(+{k=0, len(A)-1, A[k]x^(k-len(A))}))/(ln(B[len(B)-1]) + ln(+{k=0, len(B)-1, B[k]x^(k-len(B))}))}}
$math{lim{x->0+, xln(+{k=0, len(A)-1, A[k]x^k})} = lim{x->0+, x*((len(A)-1)ln(x)+ln(+{k=0, len(A)-1, A[k]*x^(k-len(A))}))} = 0}

Name: Inverse trigonometric arithmetic
Basic relationship:
$math{lim{x->1-, arccos(x)/sqrt(1-x)} = [t=arccos(x)] = lim{t->0-, t/sqrt(1-cos(t))} = lim{t->0-, t/sqrt(2sin^2(t/2))}}
$math{lim{x->0, arctan(Ax)/(Bx)} = [t=arctan(Ax)] = lim{t->0, At/B*tan(t)} = A/B}

Name: Completion using forlong
Continous function/Kontinuerligt
Basic relationship: f(x) continous in a, if $math{lim{x->a, f(x)=f(a)}
Informal definitions: Coherent (sammanhängande), no gaps (inga hopp) in the domain

Name: The Extreme Value Theorem/Satsen om max/min, Weierstrass sats
Basic relationship: f continous $math{[a, b]} -> x, x assumes a local maximum or minimum value

$math{f(x)=(sin^2(x)-tan(x))/(x^2+sqrt(x)+1)}
Continous in $math{[0, 1]} -> both max and min value
$math{(0, 1)} -> no conclusion since open interval
$math{[0,2]} function not defined in full interval since $math{tan(x)} undefined $math{x=\pi/2}.

Name: The Intermediate Value Theorem/Satsen om mellanliggande värde
Basic relationship: f continous $math{[a, b]}, f must take all the intermediate value between $math{f(a)} and $math{f(b)}
Check root for $math{x^3+x+1=0} between $math{[-1, 1]} -> $math{f(-1)=-1}, $math{f(1)=3}, through 0 -> At least 1 or odd number of roots
